# Dima Laundry

> Dima Laundry LLC is a Dubai laundry and dry cleaning company operating since 2001. It runs 8 retail branches (open 10am to 10pm daily) and 3 processing centres in Al Quoz (open 24 hours), cleans every item in-house, and offers pickup and delivery across Dubai. Prices start at AED 14 for a shirt and AED 48 for a two piece suit. Phone 800 DIMA (3462). WhatsApp +971 50 639 8093. Commercial +971 56 998 4493. Email info@dimalaundry.com.

Mobile app: iOS https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/dima-laundry-dry-cleaning/id6738209489 | Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cleancloudapp.dimalaundry
